description.value: Machines all over the Pact Worlds are used to assist in manual labor. These machines are often practical in appearance, sturdy in build, and inexpensive to maintain. They often work in conditions that would kill an organic laborer. Whether you were a free-floating vacuum miner in the Diaspora or a bot that worked on the assembly line to create Drift engines, you eventually realized you were more than just the tasks you were programmed to accomplish. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Hefty Hauler] skill feat.
